content.content:
Buys-The-Months: "I have no work for you. Salts-The-Catch keeps a house in Lilmoth. She asked me for anyone off my ship who saw the camp burn. A guest of hers, Nesh-Deeka, pays for work. Go to Nesh-Deeka. Keep to the shore going east, a fair way. You pass the old lighthouse, and then you are in Lilmoth. Keep on until you reach the second of the big ships, the one at anchor off Lilmoth's own dock. Salts-The-Catch's house is south of that ship, beside a wooden walkway."
Objective completed: Speak to Buys-The-Months on the deck of the ship.
Journal entry (No Name on the Work Roll): Buys-The-Months, the broker, holds his gang's Owing, the months of work they owe. I am on no line of his roll, so he will not keep me. He says Nesh-Deeka, a guest at Salts-The-Catch's house south of the second big ship off Lilmoth's dock, pays for work. I'm to find her there, east along the shore.
New objective: Find Nesh-Deeka in Salts-The-Catch's house, south of the second big ship, anchored off Lilmoth's own dock.

content.content:
Nesh-Deeka: "Sit. Salts-The-Catch told me what Buys-The-Months said of you. I am Nesh-Deeka, and I do not lie well to a face, so I will tell you plainly. Two nights ago the gang's camp up the estuary burned. A woman with a knotted cord at her wrist killed the courier who walked with the gang. She took his satchel. The satchel was mine. Her people also cut the camp's Hist cutting, a slip of the sacred tree from which the families draw their lives. They cut it away from the eggs at its roots. The eggs died. The gang say she looked at you lying by the fire and let you live. I serve the Veiled Reed, the quiet service of the An-Xileel, the state that rules Black Marsh. Do not say that name to a stranger. Not here, not where others can hear. I have work for a hand whose name is on no roll. Ask me whatever you like about it before you answer. I will tell you what I can, and where I am holding back."
Objective completed: Find Nesh-Deeka in Salts-The-Catch's house, south of the second big ship, anchored off Lilmoth's own dock.
Journal entry (No Name on the Work Roll): A woman with a knotted cord killed Nesh-Deeka's courier at the gang's camp the night it burned, took his satchel and let me live. Nesh-Deeka serves the Veiled Reed, the state's quiet service, and wants a hand whose name is on no roll. I'm to hear her out and say whether I will work for the Reed.
New objective: Hear Nesh-Deeka out, then give her an answer on the Veiled Reed's offer.

content.content:
== No Name on the Work Roll (completed)
- I woke in the hold of a ship, moored below Hereguard Plantation, west of Lilmoth in Black Marsh, among a gang of Argonians I do not know. I'm to go up the stairs and out of the door to the deck, and speak to the man who stands there.
- Buys-The-Months, the broker, holds his gang's Owing, the months of work they owe. I am on no line of his roll, so he will not keep me. He says Nesh-Deeka, a guest at Salts-The-Catch's house south of the second big ship off Lilmoth's dock, pays for work. I'm to find her there, east along the shore.
- A woman with a knotted cord killed Nesh-Deeka's courier at the gang's camp the night it burned, took his satchel and let me live. Nesh-Deeka serves the Veiled Reed, the state's quiet service, and wants a hand whose name is on no roll. I'm to hear her out and say whether I will work for the Reed.
- I took work with the Veiled Reed, and Nesh-Deeka put fifty gold in my hand. She has told me the first work the Reed wants of me. Why the woman with the knotted cord let me live, I still do not know.
== The Cutters' Jar (completed)
- Nesh-Deeka gave me the Veiled Reed's first work. Dives-Without-A-Rope, one of the broker's gang, carried off a jar of sap that the cutters dropped at the burnt camp. Nesh-Deeka wants it to learn what the cutters wanted. I'm to ask Dives-Without-A-Rope for the jar in the ship's hold at the pier west of Lilmoth.
- I paid Dives-Without-A-Rope twenty gold. She gave me the key to her lockbox in the ship's hold. I'm to take the jar from the lockbox and bring it to Nesh-Deeka.
- I tasted the cutters' sap in Salts-The-Catch's house. Nesh-Deeka wrote down what I said under it: a ship's hold with roots through its deck, a door that was never built, a dry voice. She gave me the page and twenty-five gold. She has heard that the Hist of Low-Reed Village, east of Lilmoth, has turned its face.
